The report provides an overview of nutrient pollution in the United States, the sources of nutrient pollution, and federal and state activities to address this issue. Overall, the report emphasizes the importance of continued research and collaboration between federal, state, and local governments, as well as stakeholders in agriculture, industry, and environmental advocacy, to effectively address nutrient pollution and improve water quality.
